subtasks.name: vanishing_count
subtasks.role: Fresh within-problem scalar natural-number obstruction, square-root/rpow and standard asymptotic-equivalence bridges

interpretation.constant: Positive finite real leading/optimal-order constant, as standard for this phrase
interpretation.dimension: The universally stated dimension claim is refuted at d=2
interpretation.exponent: Printed positive (d-1)/2 retained exactly; not silently replaced by its negative
readings_refuted: Exact equality for all sufficiently small positive errors
not_claimed: No result on a sign-corrected negative exponent conjecture
No conclusion claimed for a bare one-sided upper bound
Zero is not represented as a positive leading constant
interpretation.minima: A minimum includes an actual approximating polytope and a bijection counting its actual facets; no default infimum/cardinality
interpretation.existence: Every polytope has finitely many exposed faces/facets. A minimum exists iff at least one approximating polytope exists. No unproved global approximation-existence theorem is assumed in the disproof.

A late attempt to request helper provenance through followup_task was refused by the collaboration agent limit; it performed no mathematical or filesystem mutation.
provenance.audit_scope: Audit.lean scans actual compiled Geometry, Vanishing and Solution module ownership, includes generated/private names and collects transitive axioms; it rejects added axioms and unsafe mathematical declarations. Audit.lean itself is operational tooling executed by lean and is not an imported mathematical module.
